hook_line: MORGAN STANLEY BEATS, BANK OF AMERICA MISSES

hook_stat.sub: Bank of America settlement charge behind its earnings miss

stats.label: Morgan Stanley earnings per share beat the $2.83 expected
Morgan Stanley revenue, against $19.74 billion expected
Jump in equity trading revenue to $5.80 billion

diaspora_bullets: Bank of America net interest income rose 8% to $16.4 billion
Bank of America returned $8.3 billion in dividends and buybacks
news_summary: Morgan Stanley beat estimates on both lines, while Bank of America missed after a $1.2 billion settlement charge cut its reported earnings.
payoff: Morgan Stanley posted the cleanest beat among the largest U.S. banks.
